scope: All existing routes in the 21 requested modules, including aliases and nested editors, reports, histories and detail views

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Card wrapper detached spacing and flex utilities from their content
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: ModuleCard renders direct children. Dashboard retains the original AdminCard.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Wide grids and table contents could expand the app shell
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Module-only minimum widths, responsive grids and contained horizontal table scrolling.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Oversized table rows and inconsistent native/component control styling
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Scoped table density, readable headings, uniform fields, focus states, disabled states and errors.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Financial amounts lacked consistent numeric alignment
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Right-aligned tabular amounts and matching headers; corrected empty-row column spans.
Bounded navigation with first, last and neighboring pages, accessible names and current-page state.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Toolbar displayed a nonfunctional filter button
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Only show the filter action when a handler is supplied; preserve existing route filters and search.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: New finance and campus drafts opened below long tables without focus
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Inline editors reveal themselves, receive keyboard focus and restore the opener on close.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Custom choice tiles could only be clicked with a pointer
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Academic section/type choices use buttons with pressed and disabled states.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Legacy academic pages used a conflicting indigo palette and ornate labels
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Reuse school teal, practical labels, compact card styling and accessible control names.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Staff onboarding used four narrow columns at tablet sizes
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Two columns on tablets, four on large desktops, compact actions and responsive card padding.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Select popovers could exceed narrow viewports
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Constrain popover width and allow the options viewport to use its available height.

sharedFindingsAndFixes.issue: Split form/list layouts became narrow beside the desktop sidebar at 1024px
sharedFindingsAndFixes.fix: Keep 12-column form/list workspaces stacked until the xl breakpoint; use dynamic viewport height on module routes for mobile browser chrome.

verification.productionBuild: passed: npm run build; 227 pages generated
verification.browser: Unauthenticated /admin/student-info/list correctly redirects to the login screen. No auth bypass or production mock data was introduced.

responsiveComponentChecks.method: Actual SubjectForm, DataTable, PageHeader and ModuleCard rendered into a temporary component-only preview with the production Tailwind stylesheet and scoped module styles. Empty registry; no backend data replaced.
responsiveComponentChecks.limitation: Component preview checks cover shared layout primitives; they are not authenticated end-to-end checks of every page.

remainingIssues: Authenticated visual and live API checks across all 133 routes require sign-in; source inspection and regression tests do not establish live end-to-end verification.
No custom modal exists in the active module render trees. Editors remain inline; native confirmation dialogs and existing backend gates are preserved.
42 existing ESLint warnings remain outside the changed active UI code, including Dashboard images and unused imports in inactive legacy components.
